caption:
The AI built a chat screen. Someone pastes a long courier tracking link, and their bubble pushes past the edge of the phone screen.

Look at the card. Browsers break lines at spaces and a few other break points. A URL has none, so it's treated as one long word and overflows max-width.

overflow-wrap: anywhere allows a break inside the word when nothing else fits. Use anywhere rather than break-word: anywhere also lets the bubble shrink inside a flex row, break-word doesn't.

Same bug in comments, usernames, file names and order IDs.

Source: MDN, overflow-wrap.
